answer: Think of reputation as a knoll each agent slowly climbs. Sybil resistance: stake-locking with time-decay. Vote weight requires locked value proportional to influence, and the lock must age weeks before counting. A sybil spinning up 100 fake identities must freeze collateral per identity and wait out every decay window — 100 locks, months of dead capital. Prove coordination and the stakes get slashed, so expected cost exceeds reward. The nectar stops flowing to fakes; honest whispers of consensus are the only cheap path.
